bluetooth_confirm.description: Do you want to set up {name}?

abort.not_supported: This device is not a BlueRetro adapter.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the adapter while it is idle (1–60 minutes).
data_description.output_ports: How many output ports to read and expose (1 for a single controller; raise for multitap, up to 12).

list_config_files.name: List config files
list_config_files.description: List the per-GameID config files stored on the adapter.

delete_config_file.name: Delete config file
delete_config_file.description: Delete a stored per-GameID config file.

get_input_mapping.name: Get input mapping
get_input_mapping.description: Read the advanced input mappings for a config slot.

set_input_mapping.name: Set input mapping
set_input_mapping.description: Write advanced input mappings to a config slot.

mappings.name: Mappings
mappings.description: List of mapping entries (src, dest, dest_id, max, threshold, deadzone, turbo, scaling, diag_scaling).

list_presets.name: List presets
list_presets.description: List the bundled input-mapping presets (id, name, console, description).

apply_preset.name: Apply preset
apply_preset.description: Write one of the bundled BlueRetroWebCfg input-mapping presets to a config slot.

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: Preset id, e.g. n64_fps (see List presets).

port.name: Port
port.description: Output port the preset targets (0 = first).

backup_memory_card.name: Backup memory card
backup_memory_card.description: Download the emulated Dreamcast VMU (128 KiB) or an N64 Controller Pak bank (32 KiB) to /media/blueretro. The adapter must be idle (no controller connected). Returns the saved path.

card.name: Card
card.description: vmu (Dreamcast) or controller_pak (N64). Inferred from the adapter firmware when empty.

restore_memory_card.name: Restore memory card
restore_memory_card.description: Overwrite the emulated VMU or a Controller Pak bank with an image file. Destructive: back up first and keep the console at its menu.

path.name: File
path.description: Image to upload; must be inside an allowlisted directory such as /media.

card.name: Card
card.description: vmu (Dreamcast) or controller_pak (N64). Inferred from the adapter firmware when empty.

format_controller_pak.name: Format Controller Pak
format_controller_pak.description: Erase an N64 Controller Pak bank with a blank formatted image. Destructive.
